name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A free collection of 'playbooks' one well-known engineer uses to get disciplined, non-bloated results out of AI coding tools, shared for anyone to copy.
buyer: A startup engineering lead whose AI coding agents keep producing over-engineered, expensive-to-maintain code and wants a repeatable process instead.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO adopts the skills directly so the team's AI-assisted code stops accumulating unnecessary abstractions and bloat.
A dev educator studies the structure and builds their own paid 'AI engineering discipline' course around similar principles.
A team lead cherry-picks a few skills to standardize how the whole team briefs its coding agents before a project kicks off.

money_ideas.idea: The author already funnels free skills into a paid newsletter and course; the real model is skills-as-marketing for paid training.

steal_this: Pick the three best skills, adapt them to your own stack, and publish your own niche 'skills for X framework' repo as a lead magnet for consulting work.
